p.sigma * times[None, :])).mean(axis=1)\n191:         delta_terms = d * ind * delta_deriv\n192:         vega_terms = d * ind * vega_deriv\n193:     else:\n194:         raise ValueError(f\"pathwise not valid for {name}\")\n195:     delta = float(delta_terms.mean())\n196:     vega = float(vega_terms.mean())\n197:     delta_se = float(delta_terms.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(n))\n198:     vega_se = float(vega_terms.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(n))\n199:     return delta, delta_se, vega, vega_se\n200: \n201: \n202: def fd_greek(name: str, z: np.ndarray, p, bump: float, which: str):\n203:     \"\"\"Central finite difference with common random numbers (same z for +/- bump).\n204:     Returns (estimate, se) using the per-path difference so the SE reflects the CRN pairing.\"\"\"\n205:     d = math.exp(-p.r * p.t)\n206:     if which == \"delta\":\n207:         paths_up = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0 + bump, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z)\n208:         paths_dn = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0 - bump, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z)\n209:     else:  # vega\n210:         paths_up = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma + bump, p.t, p.m, z)\n211:         paths_dn = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma - bump, p.t, p.m, z)\n212:     pu = compute_payoff(name, paths_up, p.k, p.barrier)\n213:     pd = compute_payoff(name, paths_dn, p.k, p.barrier)\n214:     g_i = d * (pu - pd) / (2.0 * bump)\n215:     n = g_i.shape[0]\n216:     est = float(g_i.mean())\n217:     se = float(g_i.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(n))\n218:     return est, se\n219: \n220: \n221: def bs_greeks(p):\n222:     d1 = (math.log(p.s0 / p.k) + (p.r + 0.5 * p.sigma ** 2) * p.t) / (p.sigma * math.sqrt(p.t))\n223:     delta = norm.cdf(d1)\n224:     vega = p.s0 * math.sqrt(p.t) * norm.pdf(d1)  # per unit sigma\n225:     return float(delta), float(vega)\n226: \n227: \n228: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n229: # High-precision Asian reference (chunked control variate)\n230: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n231: \n232: def asian_reference(p, n_ref: int = 2 ** 21, chunk: int = 2 ** 18, seed: int = 42):\n233:     d = math.exp(-p.r * p.t)\n234:     mu_g = mc.geometric_asian_call_price(p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m) / d\n235:     # pilot beta from a single chunk\n236:     z0 = mc.gbm_increments(chunk, p.m, seed)\n237:     p0 = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z0)\n238:     A0 = mc.payoff_asian(p0, p.k)\n239:     G0 = mc.payoff_geometric_asian_call(p0, p.k)\n240:     beta = float(np.cov(A0, G0, ddof=1)[0, 1] / np.var(G0, ddof=1))\n241:     tot = 0.0\n242:     ssq = 0.0\n243:     n_done = 0\n244:     for c in range(n_ref // chunk):\n245:         z = mc.gbm_increments(chunk, p.m, seed + 10000 + c)\n246:         paths = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z)\n247:         A = mc.payoff_asian(paths, p.k)\n248:         G = mc.payoff_geometric_asian_call(paths, p.k)\n249:         cv_i = A - beta * (G - mu_g)\n250:         tot += float(cv_i.sum())\n251:         ssq += float((cv_i ** 2).sum())\n252:         n_done += chunk\n253:     est = tot / n_done\n254:     var_cv = (ssq - tot * tot / n_done) / (n_done - 1)\n255:     se = d * math.sqrt(var_cv / n_done)\n256:     return float(d * est), float(se)\n257: \n258: \n259: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n260: # Convergence experiment\n261: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n262: \n263: def convergence_experiment(p, ref_asian: float, rng_seed_base: int = 2000, reps: int = 20):\n264:     d = math.exp(-p.r * p.t)\n265:     ref_vanilla = mc.black_scholes_call(p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t)\n266:     out = {\n267:         \"N\": [], \"asian_naive\": [], \"asian_antithetic\": [], \"asian_cv\": [], \"vanilla_naive\": [],\n268:         \"_raw\": {str(N): {\"asian_naive\": [], \"asian_antithetic\": [], \"asian_cv\": [], \"vanilla_naive\": []}\n269:                  for N in NS_CONVERGENCE},\n270:     }\n271:     for N in NS_CONVERGENCE:\n272:         a_naive, a_anti, a_cv, v_naive = [], [], [], []\n273:         for r in range(reps):\n274:             seed = rng_seed_base + r\n275:             # naive + control variate share one set of paths\n276:             z = mc.gbm_increments(N, p.m, seed)\n277:             paths = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z)\n278:             A = mc.payoff_asian(paths, p.k)\n279:             G = mc.payoff_geometric_asian_call(paths, p.k)\n280:             price_naive = d * A.mean()\n281:             mu_g = mc.geometric_asian_call_price(p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m) / d\n282:             beta = np.cov(A, G, ddof=1)[0, 1] / np.var(G, ddof=1)\n283:             price_cv = d * (A.mean() - beta * (G.mean() - mu_g))\n284:             # vanilla from the same paths\n285:             vpay = mc.payoff_vanilla(paths, p.k)\n286:             price_vanilla = d * vpay.mean()\n287:             # antithetic (paired)\n288:             za = mc.gbm_increments(N, p.m, seed, antithetic=True)\n289:             pathsa = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, za)\n290:             price_anti, _, _ = antithetic_price(pathsa, p.k, p.r, p.t)\n291: \n292:             a_naive.append(float(price_naive)); a_cv.append(float(price_cv))\n293:             v_naive.append(float(price_vanilla)); a_anti.append(float(price_anti))\n294: \n295:         out[\"N\"].append(N)\n296:         out[\"asian_naive\"].append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((np.array(a_naive) - ref_asian) ** 2))))\n297:         out[\"asian_cv\"].append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((np.array(a_cv) - ref_asian) ** 2))))\n298:         out[\"asian_antithetic\"].append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((np.array(a_anti) - ref_asian) ** 2))))\n299:         out[\"vanilla_naive\"].append(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((np.array(v_naive) - ref_vanilla) ** 2))))\n300:         out[\"_raw\"][str(N)] = {\"asian_naive\": a_naive, \"asian_cv\": a_cv,\n301:                                \"asian_antithetic\": a_anti, \"vanilla_naive\": v_naive}\n302:     return out\n303: \n304: \n305: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n306: # Performance: naive Python loop vs vectorized NumPy (vectorized fn is the hot loop)\n307: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n308: \n309: def asian_vectorized(z, s0, r, sigma, t, m, k):\n310:     \"\"\"Vectorized Asian pricer (hot loop for line_profiler). Equivalent to mc.gbm_paths+payoff_asian.\"\"\"\n311:     dt = t / m\n312:     drift = (r - 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * dt\n313:     log_inc = drift + sigma * math.sqrt(dt) * z\n314:     log_paths = np.concatenate([np.zeros((z.shape[0], 1)), np.cumsum(log_inc, axis=1)], axis=1)\n315:     paths = s0 * np.exp(log_paths)\n316:     avg = paths[:, 1:].mean(axis=1)\n317:     payoff = np.maximum(avg - k, 0.0)\n318:     return payoff.mean()\n319: \n320: \n321: def asian_naive_loop(z, s0, r, sigma, t, m, k):\n322:     \"\"\"Pure-Python-loop Asian pricer (numpy used only for the pre-drawn RNG array z).\"\"\"\n323:     dt = t / m\n324:     drift = (r - 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * dt\n325:     diff = sigma * math.sqrt(dt)\n326:     n = z.shape[0]\n327:     total = 0.0\n328:     for i in range(n):\n329:         s = s0\n330:         ssum = 0.0\n331:         zi = z[i]\n332:         for j in range(m):\n333:             s = s * math.exp(drift + diff * zi[j])\n334:             ssum += s\n335:         avg = ssum / m\n336:         if avg > k:\n337:             total += avg - k\n338:     return total / n\n339: \n340: \n341: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n342: # JSON helpers\n343: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n344: \n345: def to_jsonable(x):\n346:     if isinstance(x, dict):\n347:         return {str(k): to_jsonable(v) for k, v in x.items()}\n348:     if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)):\n349:         return [to_jsonable(v) for v in x]\n350:     if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):\n351:         return to_jsonable(x.tolist())\n352:     if isinstance(x, (np.floating, np.integer)):\n353:         return x.item()\n354:     if isinstance(x, (np.bool_,)):\n355:         return bool(x)\n356:     if isinstance(x, float):\n357:         return float(x)\n358:     if isinstance(x, int):\n359:         return int(x)\n360:     return x\n361: \n362: \n363: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n364: # Main pipeline\n365: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n366: \n367: def parse_args():\n368:     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Option A: Monte Carlo pricing, variance reduction, Greeks, convergence, performance.\")\n369:     ap.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42, help=\"primary numpy seed\")\n370:     ap.add_argument(\"--torch-seed\", type=int, default=4242, help=\"independent torch engine seed\")\n371:     ap.add_argument(\"--n-paths\", type=int, default=N_MAIN, help=\"main path count (2^17 default)\")\n372:     ap.add_argument(\"--reps\", type=int, default=20, help=\"replication count for VR + convergence\")\n373:     ap.add_argument(\"--outdir\", type=str, default=\"results/approach1/if\", help=\"output directory\")\n374:     return ap.parse_args()\n375: \n376: \n377: def main() -> int:\n378:     args = parse_args()\n379:     outdir = Path(args.outdir)\n380:     outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n381:     t_start = time.perf_counter()\n382: \n383:     # ---- 0. load params -----------------------------------------------------\n384:     p = mc.estimate_params()\n385:     console.print(Panel.fit(\n386:         f\"[bold cyan]Market parameters[/bold cyan]\\n\"\n387:         f\"S0 = {p.s0:,.2f}\\nK = {p.k:,.2f}  (at-the-money spot)\\nB = {p.barrier:,.2f}  (1.20 x S0)\\n\"\n388:         f\"r = {p.r:.5f}  (SHIBOR 1Y)\\nsigma = {p.sigma:.6f}  (5y realized, annualized)\\n\"\n389:         f\"mu_phys = {p.mu_phys:.6f}  (disclosed only, NOT used in Q pricing)\\n\"\n390:         f\"T = {p.t}, m = {p.m} steps/yr, dt = {p.dt:.6f}\\n\"\n391:         f\"window = {p.estimation_window}\\n\"\n392:         f\"source_last_date = {p.source_last_date}   n_returns = {p.n_returns}\"\n393:     ))\n394:     console.print(\"[yellow]Model note:[/yellow] assignment-prescribed GBM with drift r (spot-like); NOT the \"\n395:                   \"driftless Black-76 futures model. Never conflated; a Black-76 check would be labelled separately.\\n\")\n396: \n397:     d = math.exp(-p.r * p.t)\n398:     n_paths = args.n_paths\n399: \n400:     # ---- 1. validation (European vanilla, NumPy vs torch vs BS) --------------\n401:     z_val = mc.gbm_increments(n_paths, p.m, args.seed)\n402:     paths_val = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z_val)\n403:     vpay = mc.payoff_vanilla(paths_val, p.k)\n404:     mc_np, se_np = mc.mc_price(vpay, p.r, p.t)\n405: \n406:     tpaths = torch_simulate(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, n_paths, args.torch_seed)\n407:     tpay = torch_payoff(\"vanilla\", tpaths, p.k, p.barrier)\n408:     mc_torch, se_torch = torch_price(tpay, p.r, p.t)\n409: \n410:     bs = mc.black_scholes_call(p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t)\n411:     z_score = (mc_np - bs) / se_np\n412:     diff_np_torch = abs(mc_np - mc_torch)\n413:     cross_ok = diff_np_torch <= 3.0 * math.sqrt(se_np ** 2 + se_torch ** 2)\n414: \n415:     console.print(Panel(\n416:         f\"[bold]Validation — European vanilla (N={n_paths})[/bold]\\n\"\n417:         f\"BS closed form        = {bs:.6f}\\n\"\n418:         f\"NumPy MC              = {mc_np:.6f}  (SE {se_np:.4f})\\n\"\n419:         f\"PyTorch MC (seed {args.torch_seed}) = {mc_torch:.6f}  (SE {se_torch:.4f})\\n\"\n420:         f\"z = (MC_np - BS)/SE   = {z_score:+.3f}   [PASS |z|<=3: {abs(z_score) <= 3}]\\n\"\n421:         f\"|np - torch|          = {diff_np_torch:.4f}   [PASS <=3*sqrt(se^2+se^2): {cross_ok}]\"\n422:     ))\n423: \n424:     # ---- 2. all four payoffs, both engines -----------------------------------\n425:     table = Table(title=f\"All four payoffs — NumPy vs PyTorch (N={n_paths})\", header_style=\"bold\")\n426:     table.add_column(\"Payoff\", justify=\"left\")\n427:     table.add_column(\"NumPy price\", justify=\"right\")\n428:     table.add_column(\"NumPy SE\", justify=\"right\")\n429:     table.add_column(\"PyTorch price\", justify=\"right\")\n430:     table.add_column(\"PyTorch SE\", justify=\"right\")\n431:     payoff_results = {}\n432:     for name in PAYOFFS:\n433:         pnp = compute_payoff(name, paths_val, p.k, p.barrier)\n434:         pr_np, se_np2 = mc.mc_price(pnp, p.r, p.t)\n435:         tpay = torch_payoff(name, tpaths, p.k, p.barrier)\n436:         pr_t, se_t2 = torch_price(tpay, p.r, p.t)\n437:         table.add_row(name, f\"{pr_np:.6f}\", f\"{se_np2:.4f}\", f\"{pr_t:.6f}\", f\"{se_t2:.4f}\")\n438:         payoff_results[name] = {\"numpy\": pr_np, \"numpy_se\": se_np2, \"torch\": pr_t, \"torch_se\": se_t2}\n439:     console.print(table)\n440: \n441:     # ---- 3. Asian variance reduction -----------------------------------------\n442:     beta, cv_price, cv_se, cv_var, naive_var, vr_cv = asian_control_variate(\n443:         paths_val, p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m)\n444:     naive_price, naive_se = mc.mc_price(mc.payoff_asian(paths_val, p.k), p.r, p.t)\n445:     anti_price, anti_se, anti_var = antithetic_price(\n446:         mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m,\n447:                      mc.gbm_increments(n_paths, p.m, args.seed, antithetic=True)),\n448:         p.k, p.r, p.t)\n449:     vr_anti = naive_var / anti_var\n450: \n451:     # R replications\n452:     rep_seeds = [1000 + i for i in range(args.reps)]\n453:     rep = {\"naive\": [], \"anti\": [], \"cv\": [], \"cv_beta\": [],\n454:            \"naive_var\": [], \"anti_var\": [], \"cv_var\": [], \"vr_anti\": [], \"vr_cv\": []}\n455:     for s in rep_seeds:\n456:         z = mc.gbm_increments(n_paths, p.m, s)\n457:         paths = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z)\n458:         pr_n, _ = mc.mc_price(mc.payoff_asian(paths, p.k), p.r, p.t)\n459:         b, pr_c, _, var_c, var_n, vrc = asian_control_variate(paths, p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m)\n460:         za = mc.gbm_increments(n_paths, p.m, s, antithetic=True)\n461:         pathsa = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, za)\n462:         pr_a, _, var_a = antithetic_price(pathsa, p.k, p.r, p.t)\n463:         rep[\"naive\"].append(pr_n); rep[\"naive_var\"].append(var_n)\n464:         rep[\"anti\"].append(pr_a); rep[\"anti_var\"].append(var_a)\n465:         rep[\"cv\"].append(pr_c); rep[\"cv_beta\"].append(b); rep[\"cv_var\"].append(var_c)\n466:         rep[\"vr_anti\"].append(var_n / var_a); rep[\"vr_cv\"].append(vrc)\n467: \n468:     def mstd(x):\n469:         return float(np.mean(x)), float(np.std(x, ddof=1))\n470: \n471:     vr_table = Table(title=\"Asian variance reduction\", header_style=\"bold\")\n472:     vr_table.add_column(\"Estimator\"); vr_table.add_column(\"price (single)\"); vr_table.add_column(\"SE (single)\")\n473:     vr_table.add_column(\"price (R=20 mean±std)\"); vr_table.add_column(\"var (R=20 mean±std)\")\n474:     vr_table.add_column(\"VR vs naive (mean±std)\")\n475:     vr_table.add_row(\"naive\", f\"{naive_price:.4f}\", f\"{naive_se:.4f}\",\n476:                      f\"{mstd(rep['naive'])[0]:.4f}±{mstd(rep['naive'])[1]:.4f}\",\n477:                      f\"{mstd(rep['naive_var'])[0]:.5f}±{mstd(rep['naive_var'])[1]:.5f}\", \"1.0\")\n478:     vr_table.add_row(\"antithetic\", f\"{anti_price:.4f}\", f\"{anti_se:.4f}\",\n479:                      f\"{mstd(rep['anti'])[0]:.4f}±{mstd(rep['anti'])[1]:.4f}\",\n480:                      f\"{mstd(rep['anti_var'])[0]:.5f}±{mstd(rep['anti_var'])[1]:.5f}\",\n481:                      f\"{vr_anti:.3f} ({mstd(rep['vr_anti'])[0]:.3f}±{mstd(rep['vr_anti'])[1]:.3f})\")\n482:     vr_table.add_row(\"control-variate (geo)\", f\"{cv_price:.4f}\", f\"{cv_se:.4f}\",\n483:                      f\"{mstd(rep['cv'])[0]:.4f}±{mstd(rep['cv'])[1]:.4f}\",\n484:                      f\"{mstd(rep['cv_var'])[0]:.5f}±{mstd(rep['cv_var'])[1]:.5f}\",\n485:                      f\"{vr_cv:.2f} ({mstd(rep['vr_cv'])[0]:.2f}±{mstd(rep['vr_cv'])[1]:.2f})\")\n486:     console.print(vr_table)\n487:     console.print(f\"[green]CV beta (single run) = {beta:.4f};  geo-Asian closed form = \"\n488:                   f\"{mc.geometric_asian_call_price(p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m):.4f}[/green]\")\n489: \n490:     # ---- 4. Greeks -----------------------------------------------------------\n491:     bs_delta, bs_vega = bs_greeks(p)\n492:     z_greeks = mc.gbm_increments(n_paths, p.m, args.seed)\n493:     paths_base = mc.gbm_paths(p.s0, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, z_greeks)\n494: \n495:     greeks = {\"bs\": {\"delta\": bs_delta, \"vega\": bs_vega}, \"pathwise\": {}, \"fd_delta\": {}, \"fd_vega\": {}}\n496:     # pathwise (vanilla + asian only)\n497:     for name in [\"vanilla\", \"asian\"]:\n498:         delta, delta_se, vega, vega_se = pathwise_greeks(paths_base, z_greeks, p, name)\n499:         greeks[\"pathwise\"][name] = {\"delta\": delta, \"delta_se\": delta_se,\n500:                                     \"vega\": vega, \"vega_se\": vega_se}\n501:     # finite differences (all four payoffs)\n502:     for name in PAYOFFS:\n503:         greeks[\"fd_delta\"][name] = {}\n504:         greeks[\"fd_vega\"][name] = {}\n505:         for frac in DELTA_BUMPS:\n506:             h = frac * p.s0\n507:             est, se = fd_greek(name, z_greeks, p, h, \"delta\")\n508:             greeks[\"fd_delta\"][name][str(frac)] = {\"est\": est, \"se\": se}\n509:         for eps in VEGA_BUMPS:\n510:             est, se = fd_greek(name, z_greeks, p, eps, \"vega\")\n511:             greeks[\"fd_vega\"][name][str(eps)] = {\"est\": est, \"se\": se}\n512: \n513:     g_table = Table(title=\"Greeks (vanilla benchmark: BS delta / vega)\", header_style=\"bold\")\n514:     g_table.add_column(\"Method\"); g_table.add_column(\"delta\"); g_table.add_column(\"delta SE\")\n515:     g_table.add_column(\"vega\"); g_table.add_column(\"vega SE\")\n516:     g_table.add_row(\"BS analytic\", f\"{bs_delta:.6f}\", \"-\", f\"{bs_vega:.6f}\", \"-\")\n517:     for name in [\"vanilla\", \"asian\"]:\n518:         pw = greeks[\"pathwise\"][name]\n519:         g_table.add_row(f\"pathwise ({name})\", f\"{pw['delta']:.6f}\", f\"{pw['delta_se']:.5f}\",\n520:                         f\"{pw['vega']:.6f}\", f\"{pw['vega_se']:.5f}\")\n521:     for frac in DELTA_BUMPS:\n522:         fd = greeks[\"fd_delta\"][\"vanilla\"][str(frac)]\n523:         g_table.add_row(f\"FD delta h={frac}*S0 (vanilla)\", f\"{fd['est']:.6f}\", f\"{fd['se']:.5f}\", \"-\", \"-\")\n524:     for eps in VEGA_BUMPS:\n525:         fd = greeks[\"fd_vega\"][\"vanilla\"][str(eps)]\n526:         g_table.add_row(f\"FD vega eps={eps} (vanilla)\", \"-\", \"-\", f\"{fd['est']:.6f}\", f\"{fd['se']:.5f}\")\n527:     console.print(g_table)\n528:     console.print(Panel(\n529:         \"[bold]Bias-variance discussion[/bold]\\n\"\n530:         \"Pathwise Greeks apply only to a.s. differentiable payoffs (vanilla, arithmetic Asian). This module only implements the Option-B deep-hedging\n7: pipeline (single self-contained script, argparse, linear load -> simulate -> fit -> evaluate ->\n8: write outputs), per the assignment §4.4 and the AGENTS.md Option-B contract.\n9: \n10: Accounting conventions (documented here AND in metrics.json, and echoed in the terminal):\n11:   * Hedging grid t_i = i*dt, i = 0..m-1, m = 252 steps, dt = T/m = 1/252.  S_i denotes S_{t_i}.\n12:     The path array holds S_0..S_m (m+1 points); S_0 is the initial spot, NOT a decision point.\n13:   * Delta_i is DECIDED at t_i from information available at t_i only: for the neural policy\n14:     f_theta(S_{t_i}/S_0, t_i/T); for Black-Scholes delta N(d1(S_{t_i}, T - t_i)) at rebalance dates.\n15:   * Terminal hedging P&L (assignment formula, exactly as written):\n16:         V_T = sum_{i=0}^{m-1} exp(r*(T - t_i)) * Delta_i * (S_{i+1} - S_i)\n17:             - kappa * sum_{i=0}^{m-1} |Delta_i - Delta_{i-1}| * S_{t_i}\n18:             - H(S_T),   with Delta_{-1} := 0 (the initial position is charged), H = max(S_T-K,0).\n19:     Note the discount factor uses the DECISION time t_i (assignment's simplified cash-flow timing:\n20:     the increment S_{i+1}-S_i actually accrues over [t_i, t_{i+1}] but is compounded from t_i, not\n21:     t_{i+1}).  We implement it exactly as written rather than silently altering it.\n22:   * Transaction cost is charged at the decision-time spot S_{t_i}, proportional to |DeltaDelta|,\n23:     summed over i = 0..m-1.  There is NO extra terminal close-out term: the final hedge P&L\n24:     realizes the last move (i = m-1) inside the sum, matching the assignment formula.\n25:   * Premium convention: the option premium is EXCLUDED from V_T exactly as the assignment writes\n26:     it.  Adding the constant premium e^{rT}*C_BS would shift mean P&L and CVaR equally for EVERY\n27:     policy, so it changes no comparison and leaves variance/turnover unchanged; we therefore omit\n28:     it and note this.  (Consequently a good delta hedge has E[V_T] ~ e^{rT}*C_BS > 0.)\n29:   * The SAME accounting applies to the neural policy and to every Black-Scholes baseline.\n30: \n31: Risk measure: L = -V_T; CVaR_0.95 of L is minimised via Rockafellar-Uryasev\n32:     min_{theta, eta}  eta + (1/(1-alpha)) * mean(relu(L_theta - eta)),   alpha = 0.95.\n33: Evaluation CVaR is computed independently of the training loss (sort L descending, mean of the\n34: worst 5%) on held-out paths.\n35: \"\"\"\n36: \n37: from __future__ import annotations\n38: \n39: import argparse\n40: import gc\n41: import json\n42: import math\n43: import sys\n44: import time\n45: from pathlib import Path\n46: \n47: import numpy as np\n48: import torch\n49: import torch.nn as nn\n50: \n51: ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n52: sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / \"code\"))\n53: \n54: import mc_common as mc  # noqa: E402  (authoritative shared mathematics)\n55: \n56: import plotly.graph_objects as go  # noqa: E402\n57: from rich.console import Console  # noqa: E402\n58: from rich.panel import Panel  # noqa: E402\n59: from rich.table import Table  # noqa: E402\n60: \n61: ALPHA = 0.95\n62: DEVICE = \"cpu\"\n63: \n64: \n65: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n66: # CLI\n67: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n68: def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:\n69:     p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Option B deep hedging (European vanilla call, IF).\")\n70:     p.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=42, help=\"global seed (default 42)\")\n71:     p.add_argument(\"--n-train\", type=int, default=131072, help=\"training paths (default 2^17)\")\n72:     p.add_argument(\"--n-val\", type=int, default=32768, help=\"validation paths\")\n73:     p.add_argument(\"--n-test\", type=int, default=32768, help=\"test paths\")\n74:     p.add_argument(\"--hidden\", type=int, nargs=\"+\", default=[64, 64, 64],\n75:                    help=\"MLP hidden layer widths (<=3 layers)\")\n76:     p.add_argument(\"--lr\", type=float, default=1e-3, help=\"Adam learning rate\")\n77:     p.add_argument(\"--epochs\", type=int, default=60, help=\"max epochs\")\n78:     p.add_argument(\"--batch-size\", type=int, default=4096, help=\"minibatch size (paths)\")\n79:     p.add_argument(\"--patience\", type=int, default=12, help=\"early-stopping patience\")\n80:     p.add_argument(\"--min-delta\", type=float, default=1e-4, help=\"early-stopping min delta\")\n81:     p.add_argument(\"--train-kappa\", type=float, default=0.001,\n82:                    help=\"transaction cost (decimal) the neural policy is trained at\")\n83:     p.add_argument(\"--threads\", type=int, default=8,\n84:                    help=\"torch intra-op thread count (0 = torch default)\")\n85:     p.add_argument(\"--device\", type=str, default=DEVICE)\n86:     return p.parse_args()\n87: \n88: \n89: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n90: # Seeding / GBM simulation (PyTorch)\n91: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n92: def gbm_paths_torch(s0: float, r: float, sigma: float, t: float, m: int,\n93:                     n_paths: int, seed: int, dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32) -> torch.Tensor:\n94:     \"\"\"Risk-neutral GBM paths under Q, exactly as mc_common (drift r, not Black-76).\n95: \n96:     Returns (n_paths, m+1) with paths[:, 0] == s0.\n97:     \"\"\"\n98:     torch.manual_seed(seed)\n99:     dt = t / m\n100:     drift = (r - 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * dt\n101:     vol = sigma * math.sqrt(dt)\n102:     z = torch.randn((n_paths, m), dtype=dtype)\n103:     log_inc = drift + vol * z\n104:     log_paths = torch.cat([torch.zeros((n_paths, 1), dtype=dtype),\n105:                            torch.cumsum(log_inc, dim=1)], dim=1)\n106:     return s0 * torch.exp(log_paths)\n107: \n108: \n109: def torch_mc_price(paths: torch.Tensor, k: float, r: float, t: float):\n110:     \"\"\"Return (discounted mean price, standard error) for the vanilla call on given paths.\"\"\"\n111:     payoff = torch.clamp(paths[:, -1] - k, min=0.0)\n112:     disc = math.exp(-r * t)\n113:     n = payoff.shape[0]\n114:     mean = float(payoff.mean().item())\n115:     se = float(payoff.std(unbiased=True).item() / math.sqrt(n)) * disc\n116:     return disc * mean, se\n117: \n118: \n119: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n120: # Neural hedging policy (MLP, <= 3 hidden layers)\n121: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n122: class HedgeMLP(nn.Module):\n123:     def __init__(self, hidden=(64, 64, 64)):\n124:         super().__init__()\n125:         assert len(hidden) <= 3, \"at most three hidden layers\"\n126:         layers = []\n127:         prev = 2\n128:         for h in hidden:\n129:             layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, h))\n130:             layers.append(nn.ReLU())\n131:             prev = h\n132:         layers.append(nn.Linear(prev, 1))\n133:         self.net = nn.Sequential(*layers)\n134: \n135:     def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\n136:         # x: (..., 2) -> delta (...,)\n137:         return self.net(x).squeeze(-1)\n138: \n139: \n140: def policy_inputs(S: torch.Tensor, s0: float, m: int) -> torch.Tensor:\n141:     \"\"\"Stack (S_{t_i}/S_0, t_i/T) for i = 0..m-1 into a (n_paths*m, 2) tensor.\n142: \n143:     Causal: only S at time t_i (and the calendar time t_i) enter the feature vector.\n144:     \"\"\"\n145:     n = S.shape[0]\n146:     s_spot = S[:, :-1]  # (n, m) decision-time spots\n147:     s_ratio = s_spot / s0\n148:     t_frac = torch.arange(m, device=S.device, dtype=S.dtype) / m\n149:     x = torch.stack([s_ratio, t_frac.expand(n, m)], dim=-1)  # (n, m, 2)\n150:     return x.reshape(-1, 2)\n151: \n152: \n153: def neural_delta(model: HedgeMLP, S: torch.Tensor, s0: float, m: int) -> torch.Tensor:\n154:     \"\"\"Return delta (n_paths, m): Delta_i = f_theta(S_{t_i}/S_0, t_i/T).\"\"\"\n155:     n = S.shape[0]\n156:     x = policy_inputs(S, s0, m)\n157:     return model(x).reshape(n, m)\n158: \n159: \n160: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n161: # Hedging P&L (assignment formula, shared by neural and BS policies)\n162: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n163: def hedge_pnl(S: torch.Tensor, delta: torch.Tensor, k: float, r: float,\n164:               dt: float, m: int, kappa: float):\n165:     \"\"\"Terminal hedging P&L per the assignment formula.\n166: \n167:     Args:\n168:         S:      (n_paths, m+1) asset path, S[:, 0] == S_0.\n169:         delta:  (n_paths, m) position Delta_i decided at t_i.\n170:     Returns:\n171:         V:          (n_paths,) terminal P&L (premium excluded).\n172:         turnover:   (n_paths,) sum_i |Delta_i - Delta_{i-1}|.\n173:         cost:       (n_paths,) kappa * sum_i |Delta_i - Delta_{i-1}| * S_{t_i}.\n174:     \"\"\"\n175:     n = S.shape[0]\n176:     dS = S[:, 1:] - S[:, :-1]                    # (n, m)  S_{i+1} - S_i\n177:     i = torch.arange(m, device=S.device, dtype=S.dtype)\n178:     discount = torch.exp(r * (m - i) * dt)       # (m,)  exp(r*(T - t_i))\n179:     hedge_gain = (delta * dS * discount).sum(dim=1)\n180: \n181:     delta_prev = torch.cat([torch.zeros((n, 1), device=S.device, dtype=S.dtype),\n182:                             delta[:, :-1]], dim=1)   # Delta_{i-1}, Delta_{-1} = 0\n183:     s_spot = S[:, :-1]                           # decision-time spot S_{t_i}\n184:     trade = (delta - delta_prev).abs()\n185:     cost = kappa * (trade * s_spot).sum(dim=1)\n186:     turnover = trade.sum(dim=1)\n187: \n188:     payoff = torch.clamp(S[:, -1] - k, min=0.0)  # H(S_T) = max(S_T - K, 0)\n189:     V = hedge_gain - cost - payoff\n190:     return V, turnover, cost\n191: \n192: \n193: def empirical_cvar(loss: torch.Tensor, alpha: float = ALPHA) -> float:\n194:     \"\"\"Empirical CVaR_alpha of a loss vector (independent of the R-U training loss).\n195: \n196:     Sort descending, average the worst (1-alpha) fraction (the upper tail of L).\n197:     \"\"\"\n198:     n = loss.numel()\n199:     k = max(1, int(round((1 - alpha) * n)))\n200:     sorted_desc, _ = torch.sort(loss, descending=True)\n201:     return float(sorted_desc[:k].mean().item())\n202: \n203: \n204: def policy_loss(model: HedgeMLP, S: torch.Tensor, s0: float, k: float, r: float,\n205:                 dt: float, m: int, kappa: float) -> torch.Tensor:\n206:     \"\"\"L = -V_T for the neural policy on paths S (loss, larger is worse).\"\"\"\n207:     delta = neural_delta(model, S, s0, m)\n208:     V, _, _ = hedge_pnl(S, delta, k, r, dt, m, kappa)\n209:     return -V\n210: \n211: \n212: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n213: # Black-Scholes delta benchmark\n214: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n215: def bs_delta(S_spot: torch.Tensor, k: float, r: float, sigma: float,\n216:              tau: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:\n217:     \"\"\"N(d1) with d1 = (ln(S/K) + (r + sigma^2/2)*tau) / (sigma*sqrt(tau)).\"\"\"\n218:     d1 = (torch.log(S_spot / k) + (r + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * tau) / (sigma * torch.sqrt(tau))\n219:     return 0.5 * (1.0 + torch.erf(d1 / math.sqrt(2.0)))\n220: \n221: \n222: def bs_delta_hedge(S: torch.Tensor, k: float, r: float, sigma: float, t: float,\n223:                    m: int, freq: int) -> torch.Tensor:\n224:     \"\"\"BS-delta positions (n_paths, m), rebalanced every `freq` steps and held in between.\n225: \n226:     Trades occur ONLY at rebalance dates i in {0, freq, 2*freq, ...}; between those dates the\n227:     position is held constant (no trade, no cost).  Cost is still charged on |DeltaDelta| at the\n228:     rebalance dates via the shared hedge_pnl (which uses Delta_{i-1}).\n229:     \"\"\"\n230:     dt = t / m\n231:     i = torch.arange(m, device=S.device, dtype=torch.long)\n232:     tau = (m - i).to(S.dtype) * dt            # remaining time at each potential rebalance point\n233:     s_spot = S[:, :-1]\n234:     target = bs_delta(s_spot, k, r, sigma, tau)   # full target delta at every step (cheap)\n235:     rebalance_col = (i // freq) * freq        # last rebalance index <= i (int64)\n236:     return target[:, rebalance_col]           # (n, m) held-constant positions\n237: \n238: \n239: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n240: # Training (Rockafellar-Uryasev CVaR)\n241: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n242: def train_model(model: HedgeMLP, eta: nn.Parameter, S_train: torch.Tensor, S_val: torch.Tensor,\n243:                 s0: float, k: float, r: float, dt: float, m: int, kappa: float, alpha: float,\n244:                 lr: float, epochs: int, batch_size: int, patience: int,\n245:                 min_delta: float, shuffle_seed: int, console: Console):\n246:     \"\"\"Minimise CVaR_alpha(L), L = -V_T, via the Rockafellar-Uryasev form solved by\n247:     coordinate descent.\n248: \n249:     The R-U objective  min_{theta, eta}  eta + (1/(1-alpha))*E[relu(L_theta - eta)] is\n250:     jointly minimised by (i) an EXACT eta-step and (ii) a gradient theta-step:\n251: \n252:       * For fixed theta, the objective is convex in eta and its minimiser is the empirical\n253:         alpha-quantile (VaR_alpha) of L_theta:  P(L > eta*) = 1 - alpha.  We recompute\n254:         eta = quantile_alpha(L_theta) on a fixed training subset at the START of every epoch.\n255:       * For fixed eta, we take Adam gradient steps on theta through\n256:         eta + rho * mean(relu(L_theta - eta)); only the paths with L > eta (the upper tail)\n257:         contribute gradient.\n258: \n259:     A purely gradient-based update of eta is NOT used because Adam normalises the update\n260:     magnitude to ~lr per step, so eta would track the VaR far too slowly (the VaR drops by\n261:     O(10^3) points as the policy learns to hedge); the exact quantile step sidesteps this.\n262:     \"\"\"\n263:     n = S_train.shape[0]\n264:     n_train_eval = min(n, 16384)          # fixed subset for quantile/VaR and train-CVaR reporting\n265:     S_train_eval = S_train[:n_train_eval]\n266:     optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr)\n267:     g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(shuffle_seed)\n268:     n_batches = (n + batch_size - 1) // batch_size\n269:     rho = 1.0 / (1.0 - alpha)\n270: \n271:     # Initial eta = VaR_alpha of the UNHEDGED loss (L = payoff when Delta ~ 0).  Each epoch\n272:     # reuses the end-of-epoch train loss for BOTH the train-CVaR report and the next epoch's\n273:     # eta, so the train-eval subset is forwarded exactly once per epoch.\n274:     model.eval()\n275:     with torch.no_grad():\n276:         L_train = policy_loss(model, S_train_eval, s0, k, r, dt, m, kappa)\n277:     eta_q = float(torch.quantile(L_train, alpha).item())\n278: \n279:     history = {\"epoch\": [], \"train_loss\": [], \"train_cvar\": [], \"val_cvar\": [], \"eta\": []}\n280:     best_val_cvar = float(\"inf\")\n281:     best_state, best_eta = None, None\n282:     epochs_no_improve = 0\n283: \n284:     for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):\n285:         eta_used = eta_q\n286:         eta.data.fill_(eta_used)           # exact R-U minimiser in eta (VaR_alpha)\n287: \n288:         model.train()\n289:         perm = torch.randperm(n, generator=g)\n290:         total_loss = 0.0\n291:         for b in range(n_batches):\n292:             idx = perm[b * batch_size:(b + 1) * batch_size]\n293:             L = policy_loss(model, S_train[idx], s0, k, r, dt, m, kappa)\n294:             loss = eta_used + rho * torch.relu(L - eta_used).mean()\n295:             optimizer.zero_grad()\n296:             loss.backward()\n297:             nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 10.0)\n298:             optimizer.step()\n299:             total_loss += float(loss.item()) * int(idx.numel())\n300: \n301:         avg_train_loss = total_loss / n\n302:         model.eval()\n303:         with torch.no_grad():\n304:             L_train = policy_loss(model, S_train_eval, s0, k, r, dt, m, kappa)\n305:             train_cvar = empirical_cvar(L_train, alpha)\n306:             eta_q = float(torch.quantile(L_train, alpha).item())   # eta for next epoch\n307:             L_val = policy_loss(model, S_val, s0, k, r, dt, m, kappa)\n308:             val_cvar = empirical_cvar(L_val, alpha)\n309: \n310:         history[\"epoch\"].append(epoch)\n311:         history[\"train_loss\"].append(avg_train_loss)\n312:         history[\"train_cvar\"].append(train_cvar)\n313:         history[\"val_cvar\"].append(val_cvar)\n314:         history[\"eta\"].append(eta_used)\n315: \n316:         if epoch == 1 or epoch % 5 == 0:\n317:             console.print(\n318:                 f\"[cyan]epoch {epoch:3d}[/]  train_loss={avg_train_loss:8.4f}  \"\n319:                 f\"train_cvar={train_cvar:9.4f}  val_cvar={val_cvar:9.4f}  \"\n320:                 f\"eta={eta_used:8.1f}\")\n321: \n322:         if val_cvar < best_val_cvar - min_delta:\n323:             best_val_cvar = val_cvar\n324:             epochs_no_improve = 0\n325:             best_state = {kk: vv.detach().clone() for kk, vv in model.state_dict().items()}\n326:             best_eta = eta.detach().clone()\n327:         else:\n328:             epochs_no_improve += 1\n329:             if epochs_no_improve >= patience:\n330:                 console.print(f\"[yellow]early stopping at epoch {epoch} \"\n331:                               f\"(no improvement > {min_delta} for {patience} epochs)[/]\")\n332:                 break\n333: \n334:     if best_state is not None:\n335:         model.load_state_dict(best_state)\n336:         with torch.no_grad():\n337:             eta.copy_(best_eta)\n338: \n339:     return history, best_val_cvar\n340: \n341: \n342: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n343: # Evaluation helpers\n344: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n345: def evaluate_policy(delta_fn, S: torch.Tensor, s0: float, k: float, r: float,\n346:                     dt: float, m: int, kappa: float, alpha: float):\n347:     \"\"\"Return a dict of summary statistics for one (policy, kappa) on paths S.\"\"\"\n348:     with torch.no_grad():\n349:         delta = delta_fn(S)\n350:         V, turnover, cost = hedge_pnl(S, delta, k, r, dt, m, kappa)\n351:         L = -V\n352:         return {\n353:             \"mean_pnl\": float(V.mean().item()),\n354:             \"var_pnl\": float(V.var(unbiased=True).item()),\n355:             \"cvar95\": empirical_cvar(L, alpha),\n356:             \"turnover\": float(turnover.mean().item()),\n357:             \"avg_cost\": float(cost.mean().item()),\n358:         }\n359: \n360: \n361: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n362: # main\n363: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n364: def main() -> None:\n365:     args = parse_args()\n366:     console = Console(width=160)\n367:     if args.threads > 0:\n368:         torch.set_num_threads(args.threads)\n369: \n370:     p = mc.estimate_params()\n371:     s0, k, r, sigma, t, m, dt = p.s0, p.k, p.r, p.sigma, p.t, p.m, p.dt\n372:     assert abs(k - s0) < 1e-12, \"K must equal S0 (at-the-money spot)\"\n373: \n374:     console.print(Panel.fit(\n375:         f\"[bold]Deep hedging — European vanilla call on IF[/]\\n\"\n376:         f\"S0 = {s0:.2f}   K = {k:.2f} (ATM)   r = {r:.5f}   sigma = {sigma:.5f}\\n\"\n377:         f\"T = {t}   m = {m} steps   dt = {dt:.6f}   alpha = {ALPHA}   kappa_train = {args.train_kappa}\",\n378:         title=\"Parameters (mc_common.estimate_params)\"))\n379: \n380:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n381:     # 2. Simulation & independent torch/numpy/BS price check (seed 42)\n382:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n383:     console.print(\"[bold]Simulating paths and verifying torch vs numpy vs Black-Scholes...[/]\")\n384:     bs_price = mc.black_scholes_call(s0, k, r, sigma, t)\n385: \n386:     # NumPy MC (seed 42), float64 — then release.\n387:     np_paths = mc.simulate_gbm(s0, r, sigma, t, m, args.n_train, 42)\n388:     np_price, np_se = mc.mc_price(mc.payoff_vanilla(np_paths, k), r, t)\n389:     del np_paths\n390:     gc.collect()\n391: \n392:     # PyTorch MC (seed 42), float64 — independent draws (torch.manual_seed != numpy default_rng).\n393:     paths_torch64 = gbm_paths_torch(s0, r, sigma, t, m, args.n_train, 42, dtype=torch.float64)\n394:     torch_price, torch_se = torch_mc_price(paths_torch64, k, r, t)\n395:     del paths_torch64\n396:     gc.collect()\n397: \n398:     z_bs = (torch_price - bs_price) / torch_se\n399:     z_cross = (torch_price - np_price) / math.sqrt(torch_se ** 2 + np_se ** 2)\n400: \n401:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n402:     # Main float32 simulation (train/val/test, independent seeds)\n403:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n404:     S_train = gbm_paths_torch(s0, r, sigma, t, m, args.n_train, 42, dtype=torch.float32)\n405:     S_val = gbm_paths_torch(s0, r, sigma, t, m, args.n_val, 123, dtype=torch.float32)\n406:     S_test = gbm_paths_torch(s0, r, sigma, t, m, args.n_test, 2026, dtype=torch.float32)\n407: \n408:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n409:     # Model\n410:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n411:     model = HedgeMLP(hidden=tuple(args.hidden)).to(args.device)\n412:     eta = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.0))\n413:     n_params = sum(pp.numel() for pp in model.parameters())\n414:     console.print(f\"[bold]MLP policy[/] hidden={tuple(args.hidden)}  params={n_params}  \"\n415:                   f\"(input: S/S0 and t/T; <= 3 hidden layers, causal)\")\n416: \n417:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n418:     # 3. Train\n419:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n420:     console.print(f\"[bold]Training[/] N_train={args.n_train} N_val={args.n_val} lr={args.lr} \"\n421:                   f\"batch={args.batch_size} max_epochs={args.epochs} kappa={args.train_kappa}\")\n422:     t0 = time.perf_counter()\n423:     history, best_val_cvar = train_model(\n424:         model, eta, S_train, S_val, s0, k, r, dt, m, args.train_kappa, ALPHA,\n425:         args.lr, args.epochs, args.batch_size, args.patience, args.min_delta,\n426:         args.seed, console)\n427:     fit_seconds = time.perf_counter() - t0\n428:     n_epochs_run = len(history[\"epoch\"])\n429:     console.print(f\"[bold]Training done[/] {n_epochs_run} epochs in {fit_seconds:.1f}s \"\n430:                   f\"best_val_cvar={best_val_cvar:.4f}\")\n431: \n432:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n433:     # 4. Evaluation on held-out test/val (neural at 3 kappa, BS at 9 combos)\n434:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n435:     kappas = [(0.0, \"0bp\"), (0.001, \"10bp\"), (0.005, \"50bp\")]\n436:     freqs = [1, 5, 21]\n437: \n438:     def neural_delta_fn(S):\n439:         return neural_delta(model, S, s0, m)\n440: \n441:     rows = {}   # name -> summary dict\n442:     # Neural policy: every-step rebalancing, evaluated at the three cost levels.\n443:     for kv, label in kappas:\n444:         rows[f\"neural_{label}\"] = {\"test\": evaluate_policy(\n445:             neural_delta_fn, S_test, s0, k, r, dt, m, kv, ALPHA)}\n446:         rows[f\"neural_{label}\"][\"val\"] = evaluate_policy(\n447:             neural_delta_fn, S_val, s0, k, r, dt, m, kv, ALPHA)\n448: \n449:     # BS delta: 3 frequencies x 3 costs.\n450:     for fq in freqs:\n451:         def bs_fn(S, fq=fq):\n452:             return bs_delta_hedge(S, k, r, sigma, t, m, fq)\n453:         for kv, label in kappas:\n454:             name = f\"bs_f{fq}_{label}\"\n455:             rows[name] = {\"test\": evaluate_policy(bs_fn, S_test, s0, k, r, dt, m, kv, ALPHA)}\n456:             rows[name][\"val\"] = evaluate_policy(bs_fn, S_val, s0, k, r, dt, m, kv, ALPHA)\n457: \n458:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n459:     # 5. Figures\n460:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n461:     out_dir = ROOT / \"results\" / \"approach2\" / \"if\"\n462:     out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n463: \n464:     epochs = history[\"epoch\"]\n465:     fig = go.Figure()\n466:     fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=epochs, y=history[\"train_cvar\"], name=\"train CVaR95\"))\n467:     fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=epochs, y=history[\"val_cvar\"], name=\"val CVaR95\"))\n468:     fig.update_layout(title=\"Deep-hedging training curve (CVaR95 of L=-V_T)\",\n469:                       xaxis_title=\"epoch\", yaxis_title=\"CVaR95\")\n470:     fig.write_html(str(out_dir / \"training_curve.html\"), include_plotlyjs=True)\n471: \n472:     # P&L distribution (test): neural @10bp vs a few BS baselines.\n473:     with torch.no_grad():\n474:         V_neural = -policy_loss(model, S_test, s0, k, r, dt, m, 0.001).detach().cpu().numpy()\n475:         V_bs1_0 = hedge_pnl(S_test, bs_delta_hedge(S_test, k, r, sigma, t, m, 1), k, r, dt, m, 0.0)[0].numpy()\n476:         V_bs1_10 = hedge_pnl(S_test, bs_delta_hedge(S_test, k, r, sigma, t, m, 1), k, r, dt, m, 0.001)[0].numpy()\n477:         V_bs21_0 = hedge_pnl(S_test, bs_delta_hedge(S_test, k, r, sigma, t, m, 21), k, r, dt, m, 0.0)[0].numpy()\n478: \n479:     fig = go.Figure()\n480:     for arr, name in [(V_neural, \"neural @10bp\"), (V_bs1_0, \"BS 1d @0bp\"),\n481:                       (V_bs1_10, \"BS 1d @10bp\"), (V_bs21_0, \"BS 21d @0bp\")]:\n482:         fig.add_trace(go.Histogram(x=arr, name=name, histnorm=\"probability density\",\n483:                                    opacity=0.6, nbinsx=120))\n484:     fig.update_layout(title=\"Test P&L distribution (V_T, premium excluded)\", barmode=\"overlay\",\n485:                       xaxis_title=\"V_T\", yaxis_title=\"density\")\n486:     fig.write_html(str(out_dir / \"pnl_distribution.html\"), include_plotlyjs=True)\n487: \n488:     # CVaR95 bar chart across all methods (test).\n489:     names = list(rows.keys())\n490:     cvar_test = [rows[nn][\"test\"][\"cvar95\"] for nn in names]\n491:     fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(x=names, y=cvar_test, marker_color=[\n492:         \"#1f77b4\" if nn.startswith(\"neural\") else \"#ff7f0e\" for nn in names]))\n493:     fig.update_layout(title=\"Test CVaR95 of L = -V_T across strategies\",\n494:                       xaxis_title=\"strategy\", yaxis_title=\"CVaR95\")\n495:     fig.write_html(str(out_dir / \"benchmark_bars.html\"), include_plotlyjs=True)\n496: \n497:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n498:     # 6. metrics.json\n499:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n500:     params = dict(p.to_dict())\n501:     params.update({\n502:         \"seed\": args.seed,\n503:         \"n_train\": args.n_train,\n504:         \"n_val\": args.n_val,\n505:         \"n_test\": args.n_test,\n506:         \"hidden\": list(args.hidden),\n507:         \"lr\": args.lr,\n508:         \"batch_size\": args.batch_size,\n509:         \"max_epochs\": args.epochs,\n510: args.hidden))}->1 (ReLU, <=3 hidden)\",\n519:         \"payoff\": \"European vanilla call max(S_T-K,0), K=S0\",\n520:         \"conventions\": {\n521:             \"grid\": \"t_i = i*dt, i=0..m-1,        summary.add_row(\"BS delta (1d)\", label, f\"{d['mean_pnl']:.2f}\", f\"{d['var_pnl']:.2f}\",\n571:                         f\"{d['cvar95']:.2f}\", f\"{d['turnover']:.2f}\", f\"{d['avg_cost']:.2f}\")\n572:     console.print(summary)\n573: \n574:     grid = Table(\"freq \\\\ kappa\", \"0bp\", \"10bp\", \"50bp\", title=\"BS delta CVaR95 / mean / var (TEST)\")\n575:     for
